result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian access with sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. Safety is compromised by faded crosswalk markings and parked vehicles that may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Intersection Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner can block the view of pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The asphalt within the crosswalk area shows signs of wear and patching, which could be a tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed right turns by vehicles, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and signalized control adjacent to a large institutional building. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures may lead to higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle speeds during turns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds at the corners.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, providing essential infrastructure for walkers. However, a large van is currently obstructing sightlines at the crossing, and the wide roadway lacks physical traffic calming measures like medians or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vehicle
hazards.description: A large white van is stopped immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, severely blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, occupying the travel lane next to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle turning speeds and increase pedestrian exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and standing near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines, preventing large vehicles from obscuring pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
